title: deschampsia littoralis
intro: Deschampsia littoralis, commonly known as Sea Bent or Coastal Hair Grass, is a perennial grass native to the coastal regions of Europe. It has been traditionally used in herbal medicine to treat various health conditions, including digestive issues, inflammation, and respiratory problems, due to its potential health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Deschampsia littoralis include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, making it a valuable resource in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
